topic: Electromagnetic Spectrum Wavelength, Frequency, and Energy
key_concepts: Electromagnetic waves travel at 3 x 10^8 m/s in a vacuum
The electromagnetic spectrum is arranged from radio waves to gamma rays
Radio waves have the longest wavelength and lowest frequency
Gamma rays have the shortest wavelength and highest frequency
Frequency and wavelength are inversely related through the wave equation c = fλ
Electromagnetic waves carry energy called radiation
Energy is directly proportional to frequency according to Planck's equation E = hf
Energy is inversely proportional to wavelength
Higher frequency and shorter wavelength mean higher energy
Low-frequency EM waves are less dangerous than high-frequency EM waves
Ultraviolet rays can be blocked by sunscreens and infrared rays can be felt as heat
